firmware_banner: RANGE: trained +/-80 deg; approximate extrapolated PWM 789..2211 us.
PROFILE: 50 Hz, action increment 0.06 rad; both measured PWM signs negative.
GUARDS: USB trials need heartbeat and have 60 s limit; standalone keeps sensor/timing/battery stops.
REV_B: stop removes PWM only. Direct servo power remains connected.
Commands: arm, run, standalone, shadow (no PWM), keep, off, !, state (non-stopping), status, help
handoff_acknowledgement: STANDALONE: running; USB may be unplugged. Disconnect battery to power off.
